{{Quote|Hello, droid. My name is Teokuk. What do you want?|Teokuk, greeting the droid builder's droid|<ref name="Star Wars: DroidWorks">''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''</ref>}}
'''Teokuk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who oversaw a counterweight platform on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The platform was used by one of the droids constructed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Unidentified Rebel agent (droid builder)|droid builder]], during the builder's mission to stop the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from producing [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] on the planet.
